fields.note: No carbon-fiber honeycomb sheet located here lists stabilised Ec and both shear moduli in this density band. Hexcel's product list has no carbon honeycomb table. Ultracor UCF-51-3/8-2.0 on MatWeb lists density 0.032 g/cc, compressive yield 1.41 MPa and L shear modulus 0.331 GPa, and omits Ec and W shear, so it is not scored. HFT is fiberglass phenolic. HRH-49 is Kevlar 49 fabric. Neither is carbon.
